title: Kalshi Promo Code CBSSPORTS: $25 Bonus for NFL Betting

subtitle: Take advantage of the offer when you sign up and make your first trades on the platform
excerpt: Kalshi offers a $25 bonus when you sign up with code CBSSPORTS and make $25 in trades.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Kalshi promo code CBSSPORTS is trending because it offers a $25 bonus in trading credits for new users who make $25 in trades during NFL Week 1. The offer was published by CBS Sports on September 13, 2026, and includes markets for matchups such as Raiders vs. Dolphins, Chargers vs. Cardinals, and Cowboys vs. Giants.

NFL Betting Markets with Code CBSSPORTS

With the code, users can trade prediction contracts on various NFL Week 1 games. Examples of contracts include:

  • Raiders vs. Dolphins – priced at $0.635 per share to win and $0.355 to lose.
  • Cowboys vs. Giants – priced at $0.605 per share to win and $0.395 to lose.
  • Chargers vs. Cardinals – priced at $0.19 per share to win.

How the $25 Bonus Works

To receive the bonus, users must:

  1. Sign up at Kalshi using the code CBSSPORTS.
  2. Deposit $25.
  3. Place $25 worth of trades.
  4. Receive $25 in trading credits, totaling $50 to use.

Risk Management Tools

Kalshi offers risk tools to protect users, including:

  • Trading halts.
  • Voluntary exit option.
  • Custom funding limits.

Requirements and Restrictions

The bonus is only available to new customers aged 18 or older who reside in the United States and in states where Kalshi operates. The credit expires in seven days and cannot be withdrawn. Trading event contracts involves substantial risk of loss and may not be suitable for all investors.

Payment Options and Availability

Users can deposit via Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo, PayPal, Cash App, debit cards (US only), wire transfers, and electronic bank transfers. Kalshi is available in 50 states, Washington, D.C., and US territories, except in certain markets where sports contracts are not available.

Comparison with Other Promotions

In addition to the CBSSPORTS code, Kalshi offers other promo codes, such as OREGONLIVE1, which also grant a $25 bonus on $25 deposits. The OREGONLIVE1 offer is active as of September 13, 2026, and is valid for new users in Oregon.

Conclusion

For those looking to try out trading prediction markets on the NFL, the CBSSPORTS code offers an opportunity to start with $50 in credits, double the initial deposit. The offer is valid while credit balances last and can be used on various point spread, over/under, and match outcome markets.

With information from CBS Sports, OregonLive.com.
